sections.title: Umbrella-shaped tree
sections.text: Umbrella thorn is an African and Arabian tree with a broad, flattened crown, finely divided leaves and paired straight and hooked thorns. Depending on water availability and form, it may remain a shrub or reach about 5–7 m. The cream-white flower heads are about 8 mm across; the pods are characteristically twisted.

sections.title: Pods and uses
sections.text: Its protein-rich pods and foliage are important browse and fodder for livestock. This is an animal-feed use; the sources consulted do not establish the pods as human food. The plate shows the umbrella crown, mixed thorn types, round flowers and coiled pods characteristic of the species.
